name: Hayarigami 2: Keishichou Kaii Jiken File
original_name: 流行り神2 警視庁怪異事件ファイル
source:
You are part of the elite police force team. Find the culprit and his identity before he finds you. Investigate urban legends associated with bloody murders via scientific or occult methods leading to different results. And only combination of these methods can reveal the truth behind the case.

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2020/06/vn-of-month-november-2007-demon.html]vndbreview[/url]]
translation:
你是精英警察部队的一员。在凶手找到你之前，找出他的身份并将其抓获。通过科学或神秘学方法调查与血腥谋杀相关的都市传说，而不同方法会导向不同结果。只有结合这些方法，才能揭开案件真相。

[来源：[url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2020/06/vn-of-month-november-2007-demon.html]vndbreview[/url]]
